0022600160.text: The Atlanta Hawks (3-4, 2nd in the Southeast, 0.5 games back and 7th in the East) visit the Indiana Pacers (2-4, 3rd in the Central and 12th in the East, on a three-game losing streak) for Atlanta's eighth game of the season. Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), while Jalen Johnson (ankle) and Jock Landale (hip) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain) and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Hawks won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, though they lost 129-124 in Indianapolis in their last meeting on January 31, 2026.
